newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan banks lend 20 bln yen to Bangkok Bank.
newsitem.headline: Japan banks lend 20 bln yen to Bangkok Bank.

text.p: The Export-Import Bank of Japan said on Friday that it and six Japanese commercial banks had agreed to lend a total of 20 billion yen to Bangkok Bank.

The proceeds are expected to be used to modernise industries in Thailand and build infrastructure for economic development in the Mekong basin countries, such as Thailand, Vietnam, Laos and Cambodia, the Ex-Im Bank said in a statement.
The Ex-Im Bank said it would provide 60 percent of the total amount, equivalent to 12 billion yen, and the rest would be co-financed by six commercial banks, led by Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi.

Bangkok Bank is the largest commercial bank in Southeast Asia and has most of its 482 offices located across Asia. Its assets amount to 23.2 percent of total bank assets in Thailand, the Ex-Im Bank said.
